notes.title: Ghetto Zombies is part of the official selection of The Hungry Ghost Festival
notes.content: [p][b]Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad at The Hungry Ghost Festival 2025[/b][/p][p]From September 6th to 13th, our game will be part of [i]The Hungry Ghost Festival 2025[/i], a community event on Steam that celebrates horror and mystery from all around the world.[/p][p]The event, organized by [b]Southeast Asia Game Aesthetic[/b], takes place during Ghost Month and brings together horror games with free demos for players to try.[/p][p]The demo will be available throughout the entire event, and we’ll also be releasing an update with several new features during this period. Play it, try out the latest content, and let us know what you think. Your feedback is extremely important for the project's evolution.[/p]
